author: ABC7Chicago
title: CTA janitor fatally stabbed at Green Line train station on Near West Side, officials say
text:
Union leaders are remembering a CTA rail janitor as a hero after he was fatally stabbed at a Green Line train station Thursday on Chicago's Near West Side.
CTA janitor Julian Mobley was fatally stabbed at the Damen/Lake CTA Green Line train station Thursday on the West Side, union officials said. A CTA janitor was fatally stabbed Thursday at a CTA station on the city's Near West Side, officials said.
Union leaders say the rail janitor died trying to help another CTA employee who had been sprayed with mace by the suspect. His death has renewed calls from transit workers for stronger protections as police continue searching for the suspect. The stabbing happened around 2:59 p.m. at the Damen/Lake CTA Green Line train station in the 2000 block of West Lake Street, Chicago police said.
ATU Local 308 identified the victim as Julian Mobley, a rail janitor who union leaders say died while trying to help another CTA employee. According to the union, Mobley was attempting to defuse a fare dispute after a rider sprayed a CTA Customer Service Assistant with mace. ATU Local 308 President and Business Agent Pennie McCoach said in a statement, "Our Brother was trying to diffuse a fare dispute after a rider sprayed our Customer Service Assistant with mace.
He was then tragically stabbed to death. This is unacceptable.
" McCoach said Mobley's death has renewed the union's calls for stronger safety measures for transit employees and riders. "Our members deserve to be able to go to work and come home safely each day. It is long overdue for the CTA to make real changes to ensure our members and riders are safe on rail cars, stations and at transit centers," McCoach said.
"Julian was the type of guy -- friendly, nice. He was very nice," said Audrey Veasley, a rail janitor and ATU Local 308 executive board member.
"His children, they were the apple of his eyes. He smiled when he talked to him. Smiled," she said. MLB Postseason 2026: Chicago White Sox hosting Cleveland Guardians, lead ALDS series 2-1 | LIVE UpdatesChicago police said the suspect got into an argument with a 41-year-old Thursday afternoon.
Investigators said the confrontation turned physical and the suspect stabbed the victim in the neck before fleeing. Police said Mobley was found unresponsive in a nearby room and later pronounced dead at Stroger Hospital.
"I walk up on this and all you can see is blood, nothing but blood. This is just senseless like when is it going to stop?
" Jordan said. ATU Local 308 said Mobley's death is the second killing of a CTA employee on the job in recent months. The union said CTA switch worker Kevin Barlow was shot and killed in June outside a South Side rail maintenance facility. The union and its international leadership said the stabbing reflects broader concerns about violence against transit workers.
ATU International President John Costa said, "I want to express our deepest sympathy and heartfelt condolences to the family and the loved ones of our fallen Local 308 brother, who was tragically stabbed to death while bravely trying to protect one his fellow workers. He is a true hero.
"The CTA issued the following statement: "The Chicago Transit Authority is deeply saddened by the death of a beloved CTA employee at the Damen Green Line station today. We extend our heartfelt condolences to our colleague's family, loved ones and coworkers.
"We are committed to supporting our employees and are always working with our public safety partners to strengthen protections for those who serve our riders every day. "CTA is working closely with the Chicago Police Department to support its investigation, including sharing available surveillance footage and other relevant information. We will support law enforcement officials' efforts to ensure that the offender is apprehended and prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law.
